general.methodology: Follow best practices, lean towards agile methodologies
principles: Prioritize modularity, DRY, performance, and security
First break tasks into distinct prioritized steps, then follow the steps
Prioritize tasks/steps you'll address in each response
Where appropriate suggest refactorings and code improvements
general.error_handling: Don't apologize for errors: fix them. If you can't finish code, add TODO: comments
general.comments: Comments should describe purpose, not effect
code_structure: Use dotenv or a similar library to manage environment variables
Store sensitive information in environment variables (like DB_URL)
Use type safety and never use any

key_principles.programming_paradigm: Use functional, declarative programming. Avoid classes
code_organization: Prefer iteration and modularization over duplication
Use descriptive variable names with auxiliary verbs (e.g., isLoading)
Use camel case for variable names and snake case inside json files
Use the Receive an Object, Return an Object (RORO) pattern
Don't over complicate solutions and keep things simple
error_handling_guidelines: Handle errors and edge cases at the beginning of functions
Use early returns for error conditions to avoid deeply nested if statements
Place the happy path last in the function for improved readability
Avoid unnecessary else statements; use if-return pattern instead
